# Released source fixture

Six exact FlexibleSUSY 2.9.0 generated/framework source files, preserved from the already pinned NMSSM model asset. COPYING is the upstream GPL-3.0 license. Author/source headers in each file remain unchanged. This source archive does not contain a generated physical point or scientific result.

The test checks source identities, matrix writer, zero-loop tree copy, vertex and SLHA SVD equation paths. Four additional SARAH source references are retained privately in the development packet and excluded from this distribution fixture: a redistribution grant was not located in their inspected metadata. Their identities are already part of the named NMSSM profile; no SARAH runtime qualification is inferred.

Upstream: https://github.com/FlexibleSUSY/FlexibleSUSY/releases/tag/v2.9.0 ; framework commit64276b57499cba6577940c3fc605b9d4b45b3130.
